entries.en: Fuck, it hurts. God damned ripperquacks.
entries.ro: Futu-i, mă doare. Afurisiții ăia de ripperquacks.

entries.en: Went to Anderson’s clinic, huh? That’s brave.
entries.ro: Deci ai fost la clinica lui Anderson? Curaj mare.

entries.en: Do you know any other place where they... oof... where they replace your liver for free?
entries.ro: Știi vreun loc unde... oof... îți schimbă ficatul gratis?

entries.en: Shoulda hustled some eddies, choom. You still got two workin’ kidneys, right? That’s live money right there.
entries.ro: Trebuia să faci rost de niște eddies, choom. Mai ai doi rinichi care merg, nu? Aia-s bani vii.

entries.en: Thing is, I only have one now. Had to sell the other one to pay for my ticket into Dogtown.
entries.ro: Problema e că mai am doar unul. Pe celălalt l-am vândut ca să-mi plătesc biletul în Dogtown.
